passage: Alice: *Privately, Alice thinks of the sapphire hidden in her boot; she gives no outward sign.* "The rain has stopped," she says clearly to Bob.

name: whisper
prior: Alice sits beside Bob. Cara watches from across the room, too far away to hear a whisper. Dan is in another town.
passage: Alice: *She leans to Bob and whispers too quietly for Cara to hear,* "The key is inside the blue vase." *Cara can see Alice lean toward Bob, but cannot make out any words.*

name: unconscious-bystander
prior: Alice and Bob are awake beside the couch. Cara remains deeply unconscious and cannot hear or see. Dan is in another town.
passage: Bob speaks clearly to Alice: "The courier said the north bridge collapsed, but I have not checked." Cara stays unconscious on the couch throughout.
